caption: The network layer packs 20 sensor packets into one uplink: 4,000 packets per minute become 200 uplinks per minute. The sensors still send all 4,000 packets; only what travels upward shrinks.

spec.title: Worked example: aggregation in the network layer
spec.aria: A four-step top-to-bottom flow: 4,000 sensors each sending 1 packet per minute give 4,000 packets per minute, the network layer aggregates 20 packets into 1 uplink, and the result is 200 uplinks per minute.
